from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EarningsRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's earnings per share data extracted from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the document")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The Earnings Per Share value; negative values indicate a loss")
    share_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of EPS reported (e.g., 'basic', 'diluted')")
    statement_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the document (e.g., 'Net Loss per Common Share')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt containing the EPS figure for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    earnings_records: list[EarningsRecord]
